visualValidation.allowedChange: none; exact endpoint pixels required across both exact production SHAs

fieldProvenance.renderer.geometries: G.renderer.info.memory.geometries: Three WebGLGeometries registrations minus disposal; renderer-wide, including registered geometry outside G.scene. Not bytes or a count of current G.scene objects.
fieldProvenance.renderer.textures: G.renderer.info.memory.textures: renderer-managed WebGL texture allocations/cache-key variants and render-target textures minus deletion. Not scene texture references or driver VRAM bytes.
fieldProvenance.renderer.programs: G.renderer.info.programs.length: renderer program-cache entries, including prior owners until release.
fieldProvenance.uniqueGeometries: Unique object identities found by G.scene.traverse; includes invisible descendants, excludes private Showcase/portrait/post/environment scenes not rooted under G.scene.
fieldProvenance.uniqueAttributeBackingBytes: Deduplicated ArrayBuffer.byteLength for geometry.attributes and index arrays reachable under G.scene, including complete shared backing buffers rather than just view byte lengths; excludes morph attributes, object instanceMatrix/instanceColor, textures, skeleton textures and private-scene/post resources. Not GPU bytes.
fieldProvenance.heap: performance.memory snapshot; separate CDP JSHeap fields are also recorded. No forced GC; ending snapshots include endpoint capture/serialization. APIs have different scopes and must not be summed or presented as a leak/peak measurement.

resourceEvidence.cause: Unknown. The same A revision differs between first and last trial, so the difference is not uniquely attributable to candidate source. Boot/showcase/private-scene/resource-history paths are plausible investigation targets but no creation/disposal ledger or readiness snapshot identifies the four geometries/one texture.

adoptionBlockers: Only calibration: four trials, six frame samples per trial, five pacing intervals; per-trial p95/p99 equal the maximum. No eight-trial performance measurement or confidence interval.
Candidate aggregate completed-frame time is slower by the recorded raw cost change; pacing is also slower. Neither value may be omitted or explained away as proven noise.

Renderer-wide resource counts differ within the exact baseline revision; current readiness/identity snapshots do not identify their owner/history. Stable main-scene arrays and endpoint pixels do not prove identical total resources.
Chronological process/order variation and observed cgroup CPU throttling confound source attribution. Boundary load snapshots do not exclude other activity.
SwiftShader serialized full-frame readback and GPU queries are software diagnostics, not physical-device FPS/GPU/input latency/thermal/power evidence.
Native source-display uses separate MeshStandardMaterial; this run exercises custom level material through native ink overlay, not an authored-Level custom grate-backface scene.
